name: Yokoze (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yokoze town emblem in red: four interlocking rings arranged in a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Yokoze, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 March 1978.

features.role: Yokoze town emblem — four interlocking rings arranged in a cross
